chunks.content: AURA is a local-first autonomous voice agent that operates on a listen-understand-plan-reason-act-verify cycle. All user voice recordings and documents are processed locally without unauthorized cloud transmission.

The AMD acceleration pipeline integrates ROCm runtime detection and PyTorch HIP execution to achieve low-latency local inference. Hardware monitoring reports real GPU utilization and VRAM without fabrication.
Tool permissions are categorized into READ (automatic execution), WRITE (requires user confirmation unless configured), and DESTRUCTIVE (always requires explicit user approval).
